title: nephrodium lorentzii
intro: Nephrodium lorentzii, commonly known as the "Lorentz's Fern", is a species of fern native to the tropical regions of Indonesia and Malaysia. It is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. The health benefits of Nephrodium lorentzii include its potential to treat various health conditions, such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties.
